# Agent Instructions

Read `VISION.md` before working. Canonical instructions live in `.norms/`; never edit this generated file manually.

Use `norms context [path] --json` to obtain applicable rules. Use `norms propose --id <id> [--scope <glob>]` when a user correction expresses a reusable convention. Run `norms sync` after norm changes.

Implement Norms in TypeScript with Bun. Use React and Ink for interactive terminal UI and their Yoga-backed layout. Prefer fast, terminal-first, non-interactive workflows.
